series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Unstable model rankings and significant RMSE variation across models suggest using a weighted combination approach with inverse RMSE weighting to leverage diverse model strengths while avoiding over-reliance on any single model.

reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=1.4756 AND combination_recommendation.strategy_type=weighted → high model performance variation demands inverse-RMSE weighting with shrinkage (recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35) to avoid overfitting
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.2: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.1696) → unstable rankings justify trimmed mean (20% trim) as robust alternative to simple averaging
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon top-4 selection exploits differentiated model performance across forecast horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.validation_summary.n_windows=2 AND strategy_guide.regularization_guide.n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
